using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Tsavorite.core;

public class DeltaLogTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback_LogsError_WhenErrorCodeIsNotZero()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var deltaLog = new DeltaLogMock(mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        deltaLog.AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback(1, 0, new PageAsyncFlushResult<Empty>());

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                It.IsAny<LogLevel>(),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback error: 1")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>((v, t) => true)),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class DeltaLogMock : DeltaLog
    {
        public DeltaLogMock(ILogger logger)
            : base(Mock.Of<IDevice>(), 12, 0, logger)
        {
        }

        public new void AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback(uint errorCode, uint numBytes, object context)
        {
            base.AsyncFlushPageToDeviceCallback(errorCode, numBytes, context);
        }
    }
}
